headline: Exchanges Took In $758 Million, Up From $223 Million
narrative: Exchanges took in $758 million across assets in the latest day, 0.284 percent of custodied value, up from $223 million. The exchange pipe measures dollars held across all assets on trading venues, and an inflow means that value arrived where holders can sell. Binance accounted for $334 million of the flow, the largest single venue in the print.
author: jordan
